description: The receiver's close() (Rust rx.close(), mpsc.rs:1698; bd-9kll.5.4) as opposed to its drop. t.p fills the capacity-2 queue and parks on a third send; t.q (a counted sender clone) waits in tx.closed(). At 50 t.r seals: t.p's parked send fails ASX_E_DISCONNECTED and t.q's closed() returns, the sender wakers first; a later try_send and reserve see ASX_E_DISCONNECTED. t.r still holds the receiver and receives both queued messages, then ASX_E_DISCONNECTED.
